decisions.problem: The fixed smoke-test port made simultaneous independent suite runs collide.
decisions.evidence: Concurrent v1.7.54 baseline produced EADDRINUSE on port 3961 while serial rerun passed.
decisions.expectedBenefit: Independent extractions and CI workers can validate concurrently without false failures.
decisions.acceptanceTest: Two smoke tests run concurrently and both pass using distinct operating-system-assigned ports.
